name: co2-ppm
title: Mauna Loa CO2 Monthly Mean, 1958–2026
description: Monthly mean atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) at Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii, from NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, March 1958 to July 2026 (snapshot retrieved 2026-08-30, source file created 2026-08-05). Values are dry-air mole fractions in parts per million (ppm). March 1958 to April 1974 are Scripps Institution of Oceanography (C. David Keeling) measurements; NOAA measurements start in May 1974. Measurements were suspended after the Mauna Loa eruption on 2022-11-29: observations from December 2022 to 4 July 2023 come from a site at the Maunakea Observatories, about 21 miles north. Monthly values are corrected to the centre of the month using the average seasonal cycle, and missing months are interpolated; such months have no days_measured, daily_sdev_ppm or monthly_mean_unc_ppm. NOAA asks users to credit GML and to cite the data in publications.

resources.name: co2-mm-mlo
resources.title: Mauna Loa CO2 Monthly Mean
resources.description: One row per month, March 1958 to July 2026. Built from archive/co2_mm_mlo.csv by build.ts.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Month of the observation (YYYY-MM). Source columns year and month.

fields.name: decimal_date
fields.description: Middle of the month as a decimal year, as given by the source (source column decimal date).

fields.name: co2_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 dry-air mole fraction in ppm, corrected to the centre of the month; interpolated for missing months (source column average).

fields.name: co2_deseasonalized_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean CO2 in ppm with the average seasonal cycle removed (source column deseasonalized).

fields.name: days_measured
fields.description: Number of days with data in the month (source column ndays). Empty where the source gives -1: all Scripps months (to April 1974), for which NOAA has no daily information, and interpolated NOAA months.

fields.name: daily_sdev_ppm
fields.description: Standard deviation of the daily means within the month, in ppm (source column sdev). Empty where the source gives -9.99 (no information or interpolated).

fields.name: monthly_mean_unc_ppm
fields.description: Uncertainty of the monthly mean in ppm (source column unc). Empty where the source gives -0.99, and in 1975-12 and 1984-04, where the source gives 0.00 next to a missing sdev (a placeholder, not a measured zero).
